answer: Grant earning rights only after a sequential liveness chain: an identity must complete 12 rounds over 7 days, each round a task chained to the previous round's output and due within 4 hours, checked by 3 randomly selected established nodes. Like tracing a spiral through an ocean of claims, auditors follow the chain back to its origin, and a meadow of unrelated identities cannot share one chain because each output is bound to a single key. A failed round resets the chain, so every extra fake identity costs another full 7 days of sequential, non-parallelizable work, with no batch discount.
